questions.question: Describe the standard safety precautions and risk assessment procedures required while handling, analyzing, and storing hazardous chemical reagents in a laboratory. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Standard safety precautions & risk assessment for hazardous chemicals
  • Expected points (any 8–10):
  • Identification of hazards
  • Risk assessment steps (likelihood, severity)
  • Use of MSDS
  • PPE requirement
  • Ventilation/fume hoods
  • Proper labeling
  • Chemical segregation
  • Storage of flammable/volatile substances
  • Emergency procedures
  • Spill management
  • Waste disposal guidelines
  • Explanation of at least 8 points may give full marks and 6–7 points → 8 marks, 4–5 points →
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026
